evidence: diff:gantt.py removes import matplotlib.pyplot as plt and from matplotlib import rc, adds import seaborn as sns
diff:gantt.py calls sns.set_theme at module setup, sns.scatterplot in add_milestones, and sns.lineplot in render
dynamic:first_target_events_from_repo records seaborn import from gantt.py line 13 and seaborn attr access set_theme line 27 and lineplot line 222
dynamic:target_local_spec_count is 0 and seaborn origin is site-packages/seaborn/__init__.py
reasons: gantt.py meaningfully imports and calls seaborn APIs
changed production code has no direct or dynamic matplotlib use
target seaborn origin is installed site-packages and target_local_spec_count is 0
no local fake target provider or sys.modules alias evidence
